name: 006_long_only_trend_tf15
hypothesis: On a 15-30m timeframe the short side of BTC carries no drift: it is pure cost. A long-only version of the same trend entry keeps the identical trigger and exit, so any difference in mean R between this idea and a both-sides version of the same idea measures how much the short side costs. If long-only is materially better, the negative results in this project are a statement about short intraday BTC, not about the trigger. [Timeframe variant of 006_long_only_trend, 30m -> 15m, mode chart: same bar counts and ATR multiples, hold x0.5, pct stop x0.707.]
